svg.title: WISTR fuel maintenance P&ID sheet 1
svg.text: Sector 1 / TK-FM-01 (3D F6). Gas unit 3 is shared with sector 6 / TK-FM-06 (3D F5). Six-sector schedule: sheet 3.
Tank A/B/C are compartments, not three separate tanks.
Cooling-air connections for the common maintenance-tank enclosure are on sheet 2. No unshown liquid junction is implied within a core pair.
Owner-defined process arrangement. Sizes, ratings, fail positions and detailed controls TBD.
Functional schematic; not to scale. Solid-dot crossings connect; other crossings do not.
